objective: Register and directly observe one no-checkout task worktree through live workspace and repository capabilities
acceptanceCriteria: dual-capability|WHEN exact registration runs|ASSERT TEST_PASS worktree-registration-tests
dual-substitution|WHEN repository and workspace paths are replaced|ASSERT ABSENT replacement-git-marker
direct-state|WHEN symbolic HEAD and commit are observed|ASSERT VALUE "registered exact branch"
no-checkout|WHEN exact registration succeeds|ASSERT ABSENT tracked.txt
ambiguous-replay|WHEN exact registration already exists|ASSERT ERROR WorktreeRegistrationIndeterminateError
partial-registration|WHEN repository registration lacks workspace marker|ASSERT ERROR WorktreeRegistrationIndeterminateError
missing-branch|WHEN reserved branch is absent|ASSERT ERROR WorktreeRegistrationRejectedError
